logger.doc:name: Log Case Update Request
logger.message: Process Layer: Received request to update Case ID #[attributes.uriParams.caseId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: vars.inboundUpdatePayload.status, priority: vars.inboundUpdatePayload.priority }

logger.doc:name: Log Case Update Status
logger.message: Process Layer: Case update returned HTTP #[vars.caseUpdateStatusCode] for Case ID #[vars.caseId]

logger.doc:name: Log Case Update Failure
logger.message: Process Layer: Case update failed for Case ID #[vars.caseId] with HTTP #[vars.caseUpdateStatusCode]

logger.doc:name: Log Case Update Success
logger.message: Process Layer: Case #[vars.caseId] updated successfully

logger.doc:name: Log Patch Flow Completion
logger.message: Process Layer: Case PATCH flow completed with HTTP #[vars.httpStatus default 500]

logger.doc:name: Log History Request
logger.message: Process Layer: Received request to fetch case history for customer #[attributes.uriParams.customerId]

http:request.doc:name: Call SAPI GET Contact By ID

logger.doc:name: Log Customer Validation Status
logger.message: Process Layer: Customer validation returned HTTP #[vars.customerCheckStatusCode] with status #[vars.customerCheckResponse.status default "missing"]

logger.doc:name: Log Customer Validation Failure
logger.message: Process Layer: Customer validation failed for ID #[vars.customerId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
var backendStatus = vars.customerCheckStatusCode default 500
var backendBody = vars.customerCheckResponse default {}
--- { status: "failed",
errorCode: backendBody.errorCode default if (backendStatus == 400) "INVALID_CUSTOMER_ID" else if (backendStatus == 404) "CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND" else if (backendStatus == 503) "SYSTEM_API_UNAVAILABLE" else "CUSTOMER_VALIDATION_FAILED",
message: backendBody.message default if (backendStatus == 400) "The supplied customer ID is malformed or invalid." else if (backendStatus == 404) "Customer with ID '" ++ (vars.customerId default "") ++ "' does not exist." else if (backendStatus == 503) "The customer service is temporarily unavailable." else "The customer could not be validated.",
errorDescription: backendBody.errorDescription default "Customer validation failed.",
correlationId: backendBody.correlationId default correlationId }

logger.message: Process Layer: Customer #[vars.customerId] was not found. Case-history retrieval stopped.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "failed", errorCode: "CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND", message: "Customer with ID '" ++ (vars.customerId default "") ++ "' does not exist.", errorDescription: "No customer record was returned by the System API.", correlationId: correlationId }

logger.doc:name: Log Customer Verification Success
logger.message: Process Layer: Customer verified. Fetching case history.
Process Layer: Case-history retrieval returned HTTP #[vars.caseHistoryStatusCode]

logger.doc:name: Log Case History Failure
logger.message: Process Layer: Case history retrieval failed for customer #[vars.customerId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
var backendBody = vars.caseHistoryResponse default {}
var backendStatus = vars.caseHistoryStatusCode default 500
--- { status: "failed",
errorCode: backendBody.errorCode default "CASE_HISTORY_RETRIEVAL_FAILED",
message: backendBody.message default "Unable to retrieve cases for this customer.",
errorDescription: backendBody.errorDescription default "The System API could not retrieve the case history.",
correlationId: backendBody.correlationId default correlationId }

logger.doc:name: Log Case History Success
logger.message: Process Layer: Customer cases retrieved successfully

logger.doc:name: Log History Flow Completion
logger.message: Process Layer: Case history flow completed with HTTP #[vars.httpStatus default 200]

logger.doc:name: Log Customer Not Found
logger.message: Process Layer: No customer found for ID #[vars.customerId]. Case will not be created.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "failed", errorCode: "CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND", message: "Customer with ID '" ++ (vars.customerId default "") ++ "' does not exist.", errorDescription: "No customer record was returned by the System API.", correlationId: correlationId }

logger.doc:name: Log Case Creation Failure

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "failed", errorCode: "CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND", message: "Customer with ID '" ++ (vars.customerId default "") ++ "' does not exist.", errorDescription: "No customer record was returned by the System API.", correlationId: correlationId }

logger.doc:name: Log Case Creation Success
